channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] South Carolina police officer killed, second injured in shooting at park
item.description: A South Carolina police officer died and a second was injured in a “gunfight” Saturday in a park, following a call about a domestic dispute, the police chief in Columbia said.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
item.description: Authorities in Nepal warned of possible fresh flooding on Sunday and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Trump calls for NBC’s Kristen Welker to face ‘rebuke or punishment’ from the FCC
item.description: President Trump said Sunday he would report NBC's Kristen Welker to the FCC for "rebuke or punishment" over her coverage of his endorsement record. The FCC says it cannot regulate news content.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man with 18 theft convictions arrested again at Tampa discount store
item.description: A man with 18 prior theft convictions is behind bars again following a shoplifting call at dd’s DISCOUNTS on East Fletcher Avenue on Saturday night, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] St. Pete man accused of exposing himself for OnlyFans content at Sawgrass Lake Park: PCSO
item.description: A St. Petersburg man was arrested after a person told deputies he saw the man exposing himself at Sawgrass Lake Park, according to a Pinellas County Sheriff's Office arrest affidavit.

item.title: [BREAKING] [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Manhunt underway after deadly Switzerland rave shooting leaves 1 dead, 5 injured
item.description: Swiss police say that a shooting at a rave in the northern Swiss canton of Aargau has killed one person and left five injured. Police said they are still looking for potentially more than one suspect.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] NASA's newest space telescope launches on a quest to explore the hidden universe
item.description: NASA’s newest crown jewel blasted off Sunday to hunt for planets around other stars, explore secret dark energy and survey the cosmos like never before.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Clear the Shelters: Humane Society waives adoption fees in Tampa Bay
item.description: The Humane Society of Tampa Bay waived adoption fees at its Hillsborough and Pinellas locations for the Clear the Shelters event, but organizers are reminding families that long-term pet care requires a major financial and time commitment.

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Tampa motel fight: Suspect faces murder charge after shooting leaves man dead, police say
item.description: A man was arrested and faces a second-degree murder charge after a shooting left a man dead Saturday night at a motel in the Seminole Heights neighborhood, according to the Tampa Police Department.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Man struck by lightning while jet skiing near Fort De Soto: PCSO
item.description: A man was hospitalized in life-threatening condition after he was struck by lightning while jet skiing near Fort De Soto on Saturday evening, according to the Pinellas County Sheriff's Office.
